title: MIHVER Publication Broker Result
description: Machine-readable shape of the Publication Broker's own output for one publish request (tools/publication-broker/internal/server.Result is the canonical Go implementation). Mirrors the Local Publication Builder's COMMITTED/BLOCKED vocabulary (schemas/dev/publication-receipt.schema.json) at the remote-effect layer: PUBLISHED here means the Broker independently verified the commit, pushed it, and (if pr_expected) created/updated a PR -- never merged, approved, or closed one. This result NEVER carries a token, private key, or any other secret -- see docs/development/PUBLICATION_BROKER.md's 'GitHub App Credential / Token Model' section.

remote_head.description: The remote branch's head SHA after this operation; required (non-schema-enforced) when status is PUBLISHED.

pr_number.description: Present only when pr_expected was true and a PR was created or reused.

failure_reason.description: Required (non-schema-enforced), exact, machine-readable reason when status is BLOCKED; absent on PUBLISHED.
